notes.title: Puzzle Galaxies - Bugfix update (Windows 10)
notes.notes:
A new update to Puzzle Galaxies has been made to handle a 'black screen' bug with various Windows 10 installations of Puzzle Galaxies.

If after playing Puzzle Galaxies (and the update has been applied, which should be automatic), and you still experience a 'black screen' issue, you may want to try uninstalling and reinstalling Puzzle Galaxies and see if that fixes the issue for you.

If this still does not fix the issue for you, you may want to manually change the commonConfig.xml to "D3D" mode.  For older versions of Puzzle Galaxies, this is set to "OpenGL" mode.

You can visit the following URLs below to read instructions on how to do this:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/463710/discussions/0/357286119104667826/

https://steamcommunity.com/app/463710/discussions/0/359543542233781111/

https://steamcommunity.com/app/463710/discussions/0/351660338679556112/


Also note - it is possible that for some users (although probably rare), that the new version of Puzzle Galaxies will 'not' work, but the old version did.  If this is the case, then follow the instructions in the above URL(s) to set the DisplayDevice to "OpenGL".  You will have to do this after installing/updating Puzzle Galaxies.

Hope this helps :)  Feel free to reach out to me via email if necessary at jeffmoretti@evermoregamestudios.com

Thanks,
